data.title: UK Input-output analysis tool: 2019 to 2024
data.summary:
New interactive tool showing the use of different products by UK industries, and accompanying guidance.
The tool shows which industries are the most significant users of a selected product, and which products are required to make other goods and services in the UK economy. The tool contains data from 2019 to 2024. All the data in the tool are consistent with the Input Output analysis tables of that year.
